create_ResidualConvUnit: create a ResidualConvUnit with a given number of features for residual convolution
run_ResidualConvUnit_forward: run a forward pass through a ResidualConvUnit on an input tensor
create_Fusion: create a Fusion module with a specified resample dimension for tactile transformer fusion
run_Fusion_forward: run a forward pass through a Fusion module with an input tensor and optional previous stage
review_Fusion_class: review the Fusion class and its two ResidualConvUnit layers for the tactile transformer
